purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of N20: attr.string_keyed_label_dict, attr.label_list_dict, computed (function) attribute defaults, analysis_test_transition and the AnalysisTestResultInfo / AnalysisFailureInfo globals (docs/ATTR_DICTS_COMPUTED_DEFAULTS.md). A<n>: every step of the 9 CLI tests in tests/attr_dicts_computed_defaults.rs (texts and expected strings extracted from the test source by artifacts/rustlit.py; native checks replicate Fixture::built / rejected / the contains assertions); B<n>: probes of the doc claims (dict kinds in rules, repository rules and module-extension tags, @bazel_tools http.bzl, computed defaults incl. the rules_cc semantics.bzl:62 _def_parser shape with cfg="exec", analysis_test_transition, genuine skylib unittest.bzl / analysistest.make). Each chain shares one workspace per side and runs its steps in order. Evidence only; not a BUILD input of any test.

reference.command_flags: --registry=file://<private copy of tests/fixtures/builtin_modules/registry> --repository_disable_download --incompatible_autoload_externally= --lockfile_mode=off --noshow_progress --color=no --curses=no --repository_cache=<private> --distdir=<private: platforms-1.0.0.tar.gz sha256 3384eb1c30762704fbe38e440204e114154086c8fc8a8c2e3e28441028c019a8 + seeded registry archives + the B3 http fixtures>
reference.external_source_file_outputs: `build @repo//:file` of a source file reports 'up-to-date (nothing to build)'; its bytes are read from <output_base>/external/<canonical>/file (ext_read) and Bazel's 'is a source file, nothing will be built for it' warning is not compared.

native.binary: target/debug/bazel-rs (`direnv exec . cargo build --locked --offline` was a no-op)
native.argv: timeout --kill-after=5 60 bazel-rs --ignore_all_rc_files --cache-dir=private-cache <cmd> [profile args] <flags> <targets> (like the Rust tests)

profiles.plain: no profile args (A1-A3, A5, B1, B2, B4, B5; like the tests)

script.rust_literal_extractor: artifacts/rustlit.py (ignored; copy of the n17 one)
script.harness_origin: /tmp/opencode/bazel-parity-toolchains/artifacts/n17-capture.py (flags, private roots, registry stubs, distdir seeding, env -i, shutdown, scratch cleanup, normalization, verdicts)

environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 HOME/TMPDIR private, umask 022; scratch under /tmp/opencode removed=True
normalization: messages: `ERROR: <path>:L:C: ` (Bazel) and `bazel-rs: <path>:L:C: ` (native) prefixes stripped (locations compared separately), 7-hex configuration identifiers replaced by <ID>; workspace / output base paths replaced by <<WS>> / <OB>, the worktree by <WT>. print() payloads: Bazel `DEBUG: <loc>: X` -> X, native bare stderr lines.

verdicts.EXACT: both succeed; query stdout or the multiset of written output bytes identical (rule warnings equal; for steps whose print() output is part of the probe, payloads equal)
verdicts.EXACT_MESSAGE: both fail; Bazel's primary message (normalized) ends a line of native stderr
verdicts.EXPECTED_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED: Bazel succeeds; native fails explicitly (not supported/analyzed by the native profile, not implemented, unsupported option/command, (configuration transition), repository_os.environ is unsupported, macro user attributes are unsupported, unsupported query expression)
verdicts.MISMATCH: exit class differs, outputs/prints differ, or both fail and the Bazel message is absent from native stderr (both strings recorded); mismatch_kind: starlark_traceback_form (same final Starlark error text), value_target_label_repr_only / prints_target_label_repr_only (bytes equal after mapping Target/Label reprs), native_explicit_gap (both fail, native explicitly), message, value, prints, exit_class

observations.exact_areas: string_keyed_label_dict / label_list_dict in rules: ctx.attr dict types, keys and insertion order, Target values, ctx.files order (stable-order dedup union), select() and select()|select() resolution incl. -c opt, dict defaults relative to the defining .bzl, providers/allow_files/allow_empty errors, label_list_dict duplicates per value list (also inside select()), loading-time default type errors (traceback form only) - all equal except the Target/Label repr. Repository rules and tags: Label resolution with the caller's mapping (main MODULE.bazel strings, main tag strings, dep extension strings -> @@dep+, Label() identity, .bzl-relative defaults) identical except Label repr. Computed defaults: per-target evaluation with name/public attrs (+defaults)/tags, None results (label and label_list), parameter defaults, zero-parameter functions, 'No such attribute X', 'expected 'label'/'list(label)', but got ...', the rules_cc _def_parser shape with allow_single_file (my_def_parser/tagged EXACT) - EXACT / EXACT_MESSAGE. analysis_test_transition objects and AnalysisTestResultInfo/AnalysisFailureInfo reprs identical; misuse errors identical text.
observations.label_and_target_repr: Output bytes differ ONLY in the repr of Target / Label values: Bazel `<target //:a>` / `<input file target //:f.txt>` and, inside dicts/lists, `Label("//:data.txt")` / `Label("@@dep+//:d.txt")`; native `<Target @@//:a>` / `@@//:data.txt` / `@@dep+//:d.txt` (str() of a Label is identical). After mapping Bazel's reprs to the native form every line is identical (dict/list types, keys and insertion order, ctx.files order and deduplication, select()/select()|select() resolution, Label resolution with the caller's repository mapping, defaults relative to the defining .bzl).

built-in computed defaults as computed-default parameters, set or unset (both: 'No such regular (non computed) attribute ...' + Available attributes): B4/cs_t_*, cs_d_* (EXACT_MESSAGE).

observations.http_bzl: Bazel (distdir-served offline) fetches http_archive with files = {...} (symlinked overlay, '@@//:data.txt' value) and remote_file_urls/remote_file_integrity, and http_file. Native: http_archive stops at the expected explicit 'repository_os.environ is unsupported in the native host metadata profile' (cache.bzl:62, via get_default_canonical_id); http_file fails NON-explicitly earlier with 'Object of type `repository_ctx` has no attribute `path`' (http.bzl:241). Loading http.bzl and binding/validating the dict attributes works natively (with different error wording, see EAGER).
observations.skylib_unittest: Genuine skylib 1.8.2 unittest.bzl loads and `query //:all` is EXACT; Bazel builds and `test`s analysistest.make targets (plain, config_settings, expect_failure) and unittest.make; native fails explicitly at analysis (toolchain resolution / rule(analysis_test=True) gates) and has no `test` command.
observations.cfg_exec_def_parser: rules_cc semantics.bzl:62 shape with cfg = 'exec': Bazel builds //cc:lib ('parser=cc/tools/def_parser'); native explicit "attribute '_def_parser' cfg=exec (configuration transition)"; when the computed default is None (my_def_parser, tagged) both build EXACT.
observations.computed_default_on_dict_kinds: Function defaults of attr.string_keyed_label_dict and attr.label_keyed_string_dict (private): Bazel builds, native explicit gap (B4e/ce_skld_fn, ce_lksd_fn); attr.label_list_dict(default = function) is rejected by both ('want 'dict'').
observations.computed_default_select: Reading a select() value (cs_sel_s, cs_sel_deps, also with -c opt): Bazel builds; native explicit (per-configuration lookup table).
observations.reference_crashes: Genuine Bazel 9.3 crashes (exit 37) for: a private computed default in repository_rule() / tag_class() (InvalidStarlarkValueException: StarlarkComputedDefaultTemplate; native explicit), a computed default reading a public attr.label() that is unset/None (IllegalStateException 'precomputed value missing for dependencies'; native 'No such regular (non computed) attribute 'dep'.' as documented), and reading unset `visibility` (NullPointerException; native explicit).
observations.native_visibility_parameter: cs_v_set: with visibility explicitly set, both build 'ps=nvis_1' (EXACT since run 9).
observations.native_queries: query --output=build, --output=label_kind, deps()/labels() are outside the native query subset (explicit 'unsupported option' / 'unsupported query expression'); Bazel's outputs are recorded (e.g. deps(//cc:lib, 1) includes the computed //cc/tools:def_parser, deps(//cc:tagged, 1) does not).

def _leaf(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt")
    ctx.actions.write(out, ctx.label.name + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out])), Info(v = ctx.label.name)]

def _w(ctx, lines):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    ctx.actions.write(out, "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

def _show(ctx):
    lines = []
    for n in ["m", "l"]:
        if not hasattr(ctx.attr, n):
            continue
        v = getattr(ctx.attr, n)
        lines.append("%s repr=%r type=%s" % (n, v, type(v)))
        lines.append("%s keys=%r" % (n, v.keys()))
        for k, x in v.items():
            lines.append("  %s -> %s %r" % (k, type(x), x))
        lines.append("%s files=%s" % (n, ",".join([f.short_path for f in getattr(ctx.files, n)])))
        lines.append("%s file_has=%r" % (n, hasattr(ctx.file, n)))
    return _w(ctx, lines)

    "m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(allow_files = True),
    "l": attr.label_list_dict(allow_files = True),
}

allow_rules_r = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"l": attr.label_list_dict(allow_rules = ["leaf"])})
skip_val = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"l": attr.label_list_dict(skip_validations = True)})
dflt = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(default = {"d": ":a", "e": "//:b"}), "l": attr.label_list_dict(default = {"d": [":a", "//:b"], "e": []})})

def _mutate(ctx):
    ctx.attr.m["x"] = ctx.attr.m["x"]
    return []

mutate = rule(implementation = _mutate, attrs = ATTRS)

def _mutate_list(ctx):
    ctx.attr.l["p"].append(ctx.attr.l["p"][0])
    return []

mutate_list = rule(implementation = _mutate_list, attrs = ATTRS)

REPRS = [repr(attr.string_keyed_label_dict()), type(attr.string_keyed_label_dict()), repr(attr.label_list_dict()), type(attr.label_list_dict()),
         repr(attr.string_keyed_label_dict), repr(attr.label_list_dict)]

defs.bzl.text:
Info = provider(fields = ["v"])

def _leaf(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt")
    ctx.actions.write(out, ctx.label.name + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out])), Info(v = ctx.label.name)]

leaf = rule(implementation = _leaf)

def _w(ctx, lines):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    ctx.actions.write(out, "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

def _show(ctx):
    lines = []
    for n in ["m", "l"]:
        if not hasattr(ctx.attr, n):
            continue
        v = getattr(ctx.attr, n)
        lines.append("%s repr=%r type=%s" % (n, v, type(v)))
        lines.append("%s keys=%r" % (n, v.keys()))
        for k, x in v.items():
            lines.append("  %s -> %s %r" % (k, type(x), x))
        lines.append("%s files=%s" % (n, ",".join([f.short_path for f in getattr(ctx.files, n)])))
        lines.append("%s file_has=%r" % (n, hasattr(ctx.file, n)))
    return _w(ctx, lines)

ATTRS = {
    "m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(allow_files = True),
    "l": attr.label_list_dict(allow_files = True),
}
show = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = ATTRS)
prov = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(providers = [Info]), "l": attr.label_list_dict(providers = [Info])})
nonempty = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(allow_empty = False), "l": attr.label_list_dict(allow_empty = False)})
mand = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(mandatory = True), "l": attr.label_list_dict(mandatory = True)})
ext_files = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(allow_files = [".txt"])})
exec_cfg = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"l": attr.label_list_dict(cfg = "exec")})
allow_rules_r = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"l": attr.label_list_dict(allow_rules = ["leaf"])})
skip_val = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"l": attr.label_list_dict(skip_validations = True)})
dflt = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {"m": attr.string_keyed_label_dict(default = {"d": ":a", "e": "//:b"}), "l": attr.label_list_dict(default = {"d": [":a", "//:b"], "e": []})})

def _mutate(ctx):
    ctx.attr.m["x"] = ctx.attr.m["x"]
    return []

mutate = rule(implementation = _mutate, attrs = ATTRS)

def _mutate_list(ctx):
    ctx.attr.l["p"].append(ctx.attr.l["p"][0])
    return []

mutate_list = rule(implementation = _mutate_list, attrs = ATTRS)

REPRS = [repr(attr.string_keyed_label_dict()), type(attr.string_keyed_label_dict()), repr(attr.label_list_dict()), type(attr.label_list_dict()),
         repr(attr.string_keyed_label_dict), repr(attr.label_list_dict)]

def _reprs(ctx):
    return _w(ctx, REPRS)

reprs = rule(implementation = _reprs)

def _trace(name, s, sl, i, b, dep, deps, tags):
    toks = ["name_" + name, "s_" + s, "i_%d" % i, "b_%s" % b, "dep_" + dep.name, "ntags_%d" % len(tags)]
    toks += ["sl_" + x for x in sl]
    toks += ["deps_" + d.name for d in deps]
    toks += ["tag_" + t for t in tags]
    return [Label("//c/tools:" + t) for t in toks]

def _pick(name):
    return None if name.startswith("none") else Label("//c/tools:picked")

def _show(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    lines = ["p=%s" % (ctx.attr._p.label.name if ctx.attr._p else None), "ps=" + ",".join([t.label.name for t in ctx.attr._ps])]
    lines.append("types=%s,%s" % (type(ctx.attr._p), type(ctx.attr._ps)))
    ctx.actions.write(out, "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

probe = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {
    "s": attr.string(default = "d"),
    "sl": attr.string_list(),
    "i": attr.int(),
    "b": attr.bool(),
    "dep": attr.label(default = "//c/tools:dflt"),
    "deps": attr.label_list(),
    "_ps": attr.label_list(default = _trace),
    "_p": attr.label(default = _pick),
})

def _show_ps(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    ctx.actions.write(out, "ps=" + ",".join([t.label.name for t in ctx.attr._ps]) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

def _t(name, testonly):
    return [Label("//c/tools:testonly_%s" % testonly)]

def _d(name, deprecation):
    return [Label("//c/tools:deprecation_%s" % deprecation)]

def _v(name, visibility):
    return [Label("//c/tools:nvis_%d" % len(visibility))]

def _noparams():
    return [Label("//c/tools:x")]

tprobe = rule(implementation = _show_ps, attrs = {"_ps": attr.label_list(default = _t)})
dprobe = rule(implementation = _show_ps, attrs = {"_ps": attr.label_list(default = _d)})
vprobe = rule(implementation = _show_ps, attrs = {"_ps": attr.label_list(default = _v)})
noparams = rule(implementation = _show_ps, attrs = {"_ps": attr.label_list(default = _noparams)})
REPRS = [repr(attr.label(default = _pick)), repr(attr.label_list(default = _trace))]

def _reprs(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    ctx.actions.write(out, "\n".join(REPRS) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

reprs = rule(implementation = _reprs)

def _trace(name, s, sl, i, b, dep, deps, tags):
    toks = ["name_" + name, "s_" + s, "i_%d" % i, "b_%s" % b, "dep_" + dep.name, "ntags_%d" % len(tags)]
    toks += ["sl_" + x for x in sl]
    toks += ["deps_" + d.name for d in deps]
    toks += ["tag_" + t for t in tags]
    return [Label("//c/tools:" + t) for t in toks]

def _pick(name):
    return None if name.startswith("none") else Label("//c/tools:picked")

def _show(ctx):
    out = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".out")
    lines = ["p=%s" % (ctx.attr._p.label.name if ctx.attr._p else None), "ps=" + ",".join([t.label.name for t in ctx.attr._ps])]
    lines.append("types=%s,%s" % (type(ctx.attr._p), type(ctx.attr._ps)))
    ctx.actions.write(out, "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

probe = rule(implementation = _show, attrs = {
    "s": attr.string(default = "d"),
    "sl": attr.string_list(),
    "i": attr.int(),
    "b": attr.bool(),
    "dep": attr.label(default = "//c/tools:dflt"),
    "deps": attr.label_list(),
    "_ps": attr.label_list(default = _trace),
    "_p": attr.label(default = _pick),
})

def _show_ps(ctx):

    ctx.actions.write(out, "ps=" + ",".join([t.label.name for t in ctx.attr._ps]) + "\n")
    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([out]))]

def _t(name, testonly):

def _d(name, deprecation):

def _v(name, visibility):

def _noparams():
    return [Label("//c/tools:x")]
